Name: Tern
Description: Tern on a Stream Deck: AI usage rings, sessions, agents and new tabs
Author: WyrmKeep

Actions.Name: Usage Ring
Actions.Tooltip: How much of one AI subscription is used, as the Tern plugin Usage Rings shows it. Press for the limits, again for their reset times.

Actions.Name: Session
Actions.Tooltip: A Tern session with a dot per agent chat. Press to show it; press again for its next tab.

Actions.Name: Agents
Actions.Tooltip: How many agent chats are working and how many finished unseen. Press to jump to the one that has waited longest.

Actions.Name: New Tab
Actions.Tooltip: A new tab in the session Tern shows, in the folder of the pane in front, with a command typed into it if one is set.
